title: Pie Countdown:
headline: A few days out: the big day is almost here, the CMO is getting nervous, and if they hit 2,500 kids on December 1st, he gets pied.
story: Someone fills the pie pan; Rod looks nervous. The cards do the talking: the big day is almost here, the CMO is getting nervous, because if they hit the goal he gets pied.
Built from the same pie footage as the Pie Tease, but with different takes and a different hook shot, so it feels new. Faster cuts. Sydney: “Have fun with this edit.”
Loops: L1 “Which means what?” opens at 0:00 and closes at about 0:05 on Rod's nervous face. L2 “Why is he nervous?” closes on the goal card. Stakes: only days left, 2,500 kids, and Rod's face.
do: Sydney says: have fun with this edit.
Hook on the cream spraying into the pan, card on screen from frame 1.
Optional: keep Rod's own “I was nervous.” under the nervous card.
dont: Don't re-cut the Pie Tease or reuse its opening shot.
No Christmas imagery: no Santa, no trees, no “Merry Christmas”. Holiday vibes only.
No logo at 0:00 and none added to the end slide.
No stock footage. No second aspect ratio.

files: Nick's editor brief on this Monday item (29 Oct). This page is that plan.
S4S - Giving ShoesDay + End of Year 2026 - client editing doc (Sydney, 19 Oct). On-screen words are Sydney's.
Pie videos - Rod (Drive): pie fill b roll3 .MOV, IMG_2675.MOV, IMG_2672.MOV, IMG_2673.MOV, IMG_2676.MOV, pie b roll .MOV, pie fil b roll4 .MOV, pie fill b roll2 .MOV
Same licensed track family as the Announcement and the Pie Tease.

Sydney's holiday end slide: Holiday_bkg_social_V1_2.jpg (light blue) or Holiday_bkg_social_V2_2.jpg (dark blue). 9:16, the Soles4Souls wordmark is already in the top of the slide. CTA text in the open middle; no extra logo.

S4S graphics package (Drive): lower third bar, title plate, underline, circle burst, focus brackets, color wipe, shape swipe, topic tag, texture and gradient loops, 1080×1920, 30 fps, ProRes 4444. The plates are empty: type the words on them. The Motion graphics tab on this page has the graphics this script asks for as transparent .mov files.

Giving ShoesDay is Tuesday, December 1st. Goal: 2,500 kids with new shoes. End of Year runs December 2 to 31; goal 5,000 kids. Spelling: Soles4Souls, Giving ShoesDay (capital S and D), 4EveryKid, s4s.org/gsd.

Ready-made in the Motion graphics tab: Sydney's holiday slide with this video's call to action already on it. Plain slides: V1 light blue · V2 dark blue. The S4S logo is already on the slide; no extra logo.
tech: Horizontal clips: crop to 9:16 with faces inside the frame. Never stretch.

Cards big and centered, out of the bottom 20% and away from the right edge (Instagram buttons sit there). Hold each card long enough to read twice: text size is Soles4Souls' most common note. Titles in Buenos Aires (Roboto Black if you don't have it), body Roboto. Black text on teal, never white on teal. The first card is on screen at 0:00 and does not animate on; later cards can.
H.264 MP4, 1080×1920, 9:16 only. Upload to Frame.io with the Edit Key in the file name.
None: Rod's dialogue is not used. The cards are the text.
checklist: First card on screen at frame 1. No logo at 0:00.
Every card matches Sydney's words exactly. “CMO” in capitals.
The hook shot and takes are not the ones in the Pie Tease.
Text readable on a phone. Nothing in the bottom 20% or under the right-side buttons.
Natural sound under the music, no clipping.
End = Sydney's holiday slide + the exact CTA from this plan. No extra logo: the wordmark is already on the slide.
1080×1920, 24 fps timeline, Edit Key in the file name.

decisions.b: The pie footage is only on Soles4Souls' Canto (RMU0H). Nick pulls it into our Drive so shots and frames can be added to this plan.

client_note: Why this matters: Giving ShoesDay (1 Dec) is Soles4Souls' biggest day of the year. This is the reminder a few days out; Sydney wrote every card herself.
